title: build: extend Windows Electron CI timeout
body:
## Summary

Increase the Windows Electron CI job timeout from 50 to 70 minutes while preserving the existing 50-minute timeout for Browser and Remote suites.

The node_modules cache result is only available after the job starts, so Azure Pipelines cannot dynamically extend the current job timeout on a cache miss. A suite-level template condition is known before job creation and lets us give only the longer Electron workload enough cold-cache headroom.

## Evidence

Cold node_modules cache misses add roughly 14–17 minutes of dependency installation and archive creation. The Electron workload then reaches smoke tests with too little of the 50-minute budget remaining:

- [build 475824](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=475824&view=logs&j=15ec5277-fdc6-550c-b203-acb65f44f31c&t=19c87eee-4f28-5155-a71e-4ac992305659): cache miss, smoke tests canceled at 50 minutes
- [build 475850 attempt 1](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=475850&view=logs&j=15ec5277-fdc6-550c-b203-acb65f44f31c&t=19c87eee-4f28-5155-a71e-4ac992305659&s=27eddb93-7805-576c-c80f-37b2176e40f7): cache miss and timeout; retry succeeded after the cache became available
- [build 476029](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=476029&view=logs&j=15ec5277-fdc6-550c-b203-acb65f44f31c&t=19c87eee-4f28-5155-a71e-4ac992305659): cache miss, normal smoke progress, canceled at 50 minutes

A timeout is only a ceiling; cache-hit jobs continue to finish at their normal duration. Existing task-level timeouts continue to bound individual test commands.

## Validation

- Azure pipeline queue dry-run
- `git diff --check`
